user.title: Grid Load Shedding
user.description: Detect utility-grid power from a voltage sensor (e.g. a hybrid inverter's grid input) and turn selected loads off while it is gone.

data.name: Name
data.hold_seconds: Hold state while the voltage sensor is unavailable

data_description.voltage_entity: Grid is present while this voltage is above the threshold.
data_description.threshold: Usually the inverter's lowest accepted grid voltage (e.g. 170 V in UPS mode).
data_description.hold_seconds: Short dropouts of the voltage sensor keep the last state for this long.
data_description.fallback_entity: Optional binary sensor that is on while the grid is present (e.g. ping of a device powered before the inverter). Used once the voltage sensor has been unavailable longer than the hold time.
data_description.battery_entity: Optional. Any sensor with a charge in percent. Adds the battery time-left sensor and the battery sounds of sound notifications.
data_description.battery_reserve: Charge the battery can't really give: the time left is counted down to this level, not to 0 %.

user.title: Add load
user.description: This switch is turned off when the grid is lost (if it was on) and turned back on once the grid has been back for the restore delay.

data_description.shed_on_grid_loss: Turn this load off when the grid is lost (if it was on) and back on once the grid returns. Also available as a switch on the load's device.
data_description.run_on_schedule: Only matters with a schedule window: while off, the window is ignored and the load behaves like one without a window. Also available as a switch on the load's device.
data_description.window_start: Optional. If set (with the end), the load runs only in this window: turned on at the start, off at the end, never restored outside it. Leave both empty to keep it on whenever there is grid.
data_description.window_end: May be earlier than the start (window crosses midnight).

user.title: Add sound notification
user.description: Play a sound on this media player when the grid is lost and when it comes back. Upload your own audio files in Media → Local media.

data_description.sound_lost: Optional. Without a sound, grid loss is not announced.
data_description.sound_restored: Optional. Without a sound, the grid's return is not announced.
data_description.volume: Set on the player right before each sound.
data_description.window_start: Sounds play only inside this window (local time); outside it they are skipped, e.g. to keep the night quiet. Leave both empty to play at any time.
data_description.window_end: May be earlier than the start (window crosses midnight).
data_description.enabled: Also available as a switch on the player's device.
data_description.battery_volume: Set on the player right before each battery sound, separately from the grid sounds.
data_description.sound_soc_50: Optional. Needs a battery in the integration options. Each level plays once per discharge, at the same window as the grid sounds.
